_readme: Hand-maintained LinkedIn posts, used when no LinkedIn API token is configured.
LinkedIn's organisation API needs Marketing Developer Platform approval; this
file means LinkedIn cards can appear without it.
To add a post: open it on LinkedIn, copy the URL from the post's own page
(the ...-activity-1234567890 form), and add an entry below. Newest first is
tidiest but the feed re-sorts by date anyway.
url    required, links straight to the post
text   shown on the card; the first couple of lines is plenty
image  optional, either a URL or a repo-relative path
